chapter: Billie Holiday, Art Tatum and Chicago hotels
title: Billie Holiday and 'Strange Fruit'
summary: The band rehearses her arrangement of 'Strange Fruit', she thanks him, and he recalls her off hours.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: I'll tell you about that a little later but let's talk about Billie. Because man, she was just a real musician you know. And naturally she was the greatest as far as we were concerned. And she had her numbers but it was the first time I had heard 'Strange Fruit'. And I was really impressed you know with the lyrics.
She wrote that didn't she? Did she write that one?

No, I don't think, I don't think she wrote it, no. But she had a lovely arrangement on it and I had guys who could read. And our rehearsal for Billie there, well man, we finished playing that number for her 'Strange Fruit' and she sang it and boy, she came over and she said, Jimmy, that was

beautiful. And she gave me a big hug and kiss you know. And I told here, I said, look honey, we wouldn't be able to do it if you didn't sing it right. (LAUGHTER). Because you're the one that's making it, you're the one that's bringing us out here because we can feel you, feel you. What you're doing, we can hear you, we feel you so that's you, you're beautiful.
Was this before her drug problem?

I think it was inbetween. Because it seemed like Billie was off and on really. She tried to kick and all but this time she was drinking a lot of brandy as I recall. But she could sing. She was singing, wow!. But we used to, you know, got to love each other musically you know. Our great respect and dedication to music and her beautiful phrasing and.....
Did she carry her little chihuahua (chiwaha?) around then? (LAUGHTER).

Oh yes. She'd come dressed fit to kill you know and the Gardenia in her hair and everything. She was a doll. I just loved her. And we'd go out and eat together and everything you know. After the gig Out to the game and stuff. Talk and have a ball.
